title: Rassistische Beleidigung und Körperverletzung – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht

extraction.summaryEn: A 52-year-old driver allegedly punched a 24-year-old woman through the window of her car at a red light after a traffic dispute, while making racist insults. The suspect then followed the victim closely and fled; the case is handled by the state security unit.
